method.environment: Fresh emacs --batch -Q children launched through Eask with isolated HOME/XDG and empty temporary workspace. No paid requests or network fixtures.
method.compilation: Separate compiled copies with source symlinks; compilation preloads the package as in the original Eask baseline. Cold compilation is tested independently by test/test-mevedel-loading.el.
method.timing: Alternating baseline/current and source/compiled, including GC. Load and install separately; first/repeated public view and full-pipeline Read; separate empty-session ListExecutions first/repeated tool. Excludes process startup, cl-lib/json prerequisites, shutdown.
limitations: Headless local fixtures; no graphical paint, remote files, real provider latency, or OS cache flush.
First view starts the existing journal lifecycle, which loads Read/search/patch through memory helpers. Read after the view measures full pipeline use, not a cold Read implementation.
Repeated Read uses the ordinary unchanged-file result cache.
Five samples do not establish steady-state performance changes at sub-millisecond scales.
